name: Lag-k retained difference with resolution-sign readout

statement.latest: \text{Let } h(t) \text{ be a } \mathbb{Q}\text{-valued readout series sampled at finite ticks } t \in \mathbb{N}, \text{ and } k \ge 1 \text{ a lag in ticks.}\quad \Delta_k(t) := h(t) - h(t-k).\quad \text{Given a declared resolution } \varepsilon > 0 \text{ (the source's stated sensor resolution):}\quad \boxed{\text{readout}(t) := \begin{cases} \text{NO\_READOUT} & t < k \text{ or } h(t-k) \text{ not sampled} \\ \text{RISING} & \Delta_k(t) > \varepsilon \\ \text{FALLING} & \Delta_k(t) < -\varepsilon \\ \text{FLAT} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}}
statement.note_ascii: Delta_k(t) := h(t) - h(t-k) for a Q-valued readout series h sampled at finite ticks t, lag k>=1 tick. First branch: NO_READOUT if t<k or h(t-k) was not sampled (the undefined case, kept separate so FLAT never silently absorbs it). Otherwise, sign readout against a declared resolution epsilon>0 (the source's stated sensor resolution): RISING if Delta_k > epsilon, FALLING if Delta_k < -epsilon, FLAT otherwise.

definitions.h: a Q-valued readout series (e.g. a water-level sensor readout), never treated as a continuum signal -- only its finite sampled values at ticks t are ever used
definitions.t: a finite tick index, t in N (natural-number tick count, not a continuum time coordinate)
definitions.k: a lag in ticks, k>=1, predeclared (e.g. k corresponding to 3h or 12h of ticks); mapping a lag in ticks to a lag in clock hours (e.g. 'k ticks ~ 3h') assumes the sampling interval is uniform over that window -- this uniform-sampling assumption must be checked against the actual source series, not assumed silently
definitions.epsilon: a declared resolution constant > 0; MUST come from the source's own stated sensor resolution; if the source does not declare one, epsilon must be labelled INSTINCT (a narrative/judgment call), never silently treated as VERIFIED/MEASURED

parents.evidence: this is a direct application of the workspace's own root primitive (a retained difference exists, delta_R = (a sharp b), Th_coqc per readout_genesis Part I 'THE ONE-LINE MASTER EQUATION') to a lag-k pair of readouts of a scalar Q-valued series, replacing any implicit continuum derivative (h->0) with a finite retained difference between two actually-sampled ticks.

PROP-NATIVE-01 is a lag-1 SE(3) retained difference between two consecutive pose readouts (Delta_k := delta_R(That_k, That_{k-1})) replacing a T*-relative non-readout error definition. This proposal generalises the same forced move -- retained difference between readouts, no unobserved 'true' quantity -- from a single-lag SE(3) pose difference to a general lag-k scalar Q-valued series, and adds an explicit epsilon-resolution sign classification that PROP-NATIVE-01 itself does not need (pose refinement has no RISING/FALLING/FLAT question).

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part I, 'THE ONE-LINE MASTER EQUATION' (delta_R = (a sharp b), tier Th_coqc; the identifier 'InfoRetainedDistinctionForcesLaplacian' is relayed verbatim from that section's own text -- no corresponding .v file was located in this repository during this registration, so the identifier is cited as relayed, not independently verified) and Part V-A A.1 'The root of reality is not a domain' ('Retention comes first: delta_R = (a sharp b) composes two retained differences')
genesis_compatibility.quote: "Retention comes first: `δ_R = (a ♯ b)` composes two retained differences" (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, Part V-A, section A.1)
genesis_compatibility.note: Delta_k(t) is exactly a delta_R composition of the two retained readouts h(t) and h(t-k); it instantiates the retention gate directly, it does not need a new Genesis gate. root-level caution D applies: 'Do not confuse readout with the underlying reality' -- Delta_k is a readout of two sensor readings, never a claim about the physical flood state itself.

honest_caveats: This is a retained difference, not a derivative -- no h->0 limit is taken or implied (information-discrete-math I2 discipline: a finite step / a tau_c floor, never infinite divisibility).
It is not a forecast: RISING/FALLING/FLAT describes the sign of an already-observed retained difference between two past readouts, not a prediction of a future reading.

epsilon must be sourced honestly: if the declaring source (e.g. an official agency sensor spec) states a resolution, tag it MEASURED/VERIFIED as appropriate and cite the source; if no source states one, epsilon is INSTINCT (a judgment call) and must be labelled as such, never presented as a checked fact.

Delta_k(t) is a difference of two separately-resolved readings (h(t) and h(t-k)), each already subject to the source's own +/- epsilon resolution -- worst case, the retained difference itself carries up to 2*epsilon of resolution slack, not epsilon; the sign classification's epsilon threshold should be read with that combined uncertainty in mind, not as if only one reading were uncertain.

This is now a four-way exhaustive partition by construction: NO_READOUT (undefined input) is a separate, explicit branch, never absorbed into FLAT -- FLAT means 'sampled, retained difference within resolution', not 'no data'.

name: Time-to-threshold by linear extension of the last retained difference, with refusal

statement.latest: \text{Given } \Delta_k(t) \text{ from PROP-FLOOD-01 and a threshold } \theta \in \mathbb{Q} \text{ (an official agency threshold, e.g. BMA critical\_level):}\quad T_k := \frac{(\theta - h(t))\cdot k}{\Delta_k(t)} \text{ ticks}, \quad \text{defined ONLY when } \Delta_k(t) > \varepsilon \text{ AND } h(t) < \theta.\quad \boxed{\text{otherwise (}\Delta_k(t)\le\varepsilon\text{, or }h(t)\ge\theta\text{, or PROP-FLOOD-01's NO\_READOUT): readout} := \text{REFUSED (a non-value, not a number)}}
statement.note_ascii: T_k := (theta - h(t)) * k / Delta_k(t) ticks, defined ONLY when Delta_k(t) > epsilon (strictly rising above resolution) AND h(t) < theta (threshold not yet reached). Otherwise -- Delta_k(t) <= epsilon, or h(t) >= theta, or the input Delta_k(t) was itself NO_READOUT (PROP-FLOOD-01) -- the readout is REFUSED: REFUSED is a non-value, not a number (see honest_caveats for the contrast with a different, already-registered construction's convention). REFUSED carries one of two reason codes: UNRESOLVED when |Delta_k(t)| <= epsilon (the retained difference itself cannot be distinguished from zero at the declared resolution -- a genuine bottom/undefined case), or NOT_APPLICABLE when Delta_k(t) < -epsilon (falling, extension to theta is not meaningful), h(t) >= theta (threshold already crossed), or the input was NO_READOUT (a determinate reason the construction does not apply, not an unresolved one).

recommended_use: Report T_k for two predeclared lags (e.g. k corresponding to 3h and 12h) as an interval [min, max] of the two T_k values, never as a single point number; T_k is a rational readout of the CURRENT retained difference extended linearly, not a prediction of future behaviour, and it carries no claim that the rate Delta_k(t)/k will hold going forward.

parents.evidence: T_k linearly extends the already-defined Delta_k(t)/k rate (retained difference per tick) forward to the point where h would cross theta under that same rate held constant; it adds no new primitive beyond PROP-FLOOD-01's Delta_k and reuses its epsilon-resolution gate (and its NO_READOUT branch) as the totality condition for when the extension is licensed at all.

T_k is built entirely from the retained difference Delta_k(t) (itself an instance_of delta_R) and rational arithmetic on it; no quantity outside the retained readouts h(t), h(t-k) and the declared theta/epsilon constants ever enters.

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part V-A (A.13 seven-gate box), specifically the admissibility certificate '[C in {1,0,⊥}] Adm_n' in the pipeline 'delta_R => S_n ->[E_a] z_a^cand ->[Suff_{a,L}] z_a ->[C in {1,0,⊥}] Adm_n' and the root-level caution list item stating an unresolved readout 'is not obstructed' rather than silently suppressed or fabricated
genesis_compatibility.quote: "δ_R ⇒ 𝔖_n →[E_α] 𝔃_α^cand →[Suff_{α,L}] 𝔃_α →[𝒞∈{1,0,⊥}] Adm_n" and "【Unresolved is not obstructed, and neither one is impossible】" (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, Part V-A, A.13 seven-gate box and boxed verdict)
genesis_compatibility.note: The REFUSED branch of T_k is exactly the ternary admissibility certificate's third value (bottom/undefined, distinct from both 1=admissible and 0=inadmissible-but-defined) -- Genesis licenses a total, first-class 'unresolved' outcome here, which is why REFUSED must be a real returned state, not a silently-dropped case and not a fabricated unbounded stand-in value. This proposal further splits REFUSED into UNRESOLVED (the genuine bottom/undefined case, |Delta_k(t)|<=epsilon) and NOT_APPLICABLE (a determinate reason the construction does not apply: falling, threshold already crossed, or NO_READOUT input) -- only UNRESOLVED is the Genesis ⊥ value proper; NOT_APPLICABLE is a 0 (inadmissible-but-defined) case that happens to also return no T_k value.

claim_boundary: No hydrological/hydraulic model content of any kind is asserted (no rainfall-runoff, no channel routing, no drainage capacity). Validity is limited strictly to: the arithmetic of T_k is computed on Q (no floating-point continuum shortcuts, no h->0), and the REFUSED branch is total -- every (Delta_k(t), h(t), theta, epsilon) input, including PROP-FLOOD-01's own NO_READOUT case, produces either a well-defined T_k or an explicit REFUSED (tagged UNRESOLVED or NOT_APPLICABLE), with no third silently-undefined case.
honest_caveats: This is a linear extension of the CURRENT retained difference, not a forecast or a model of future flood dynamics -- Delta_k(t) holding constant going forward is an assumption this construction makes visible, never a claim that it will actually hold.

Recommended use is to report T_k for two lags as an interval, never a single number, precisely because different lags will generally disagree and collapsing them into one number hides that disagreement.

The REFUSED branch is a deliberate design choice to NOT adopt PROP-CONF-01's unbounded-quantile fail-closed convention (that construction's own boundary value is a symbolic unbounded quantity in its own registration) -- that convention exists for a different, already-registered purpose (a calibrated split-conformal quantile with a formal exchangeability guarantee) and is not reused here, per the zero/unbounded-value non-readout guard: rational arithmetic has no such unbounded value; a 'no value' state must be represented as an explicit refusal, not as a number.

epsilon is shared with PROP-FLOOD-01 and inherits the same sourcing requirement (MEASURED/VERIFIED only if a source states it, else INSTINCT) and the same combined-resolution caveat (Delta_k(t) carries up to 2*epsilon of resolution slack, not epsilon, since it differences two separately-resolved readings).
Not yet implemented or tested against real Sammakorn village flood-readout data; this is a design-stage proposal.
